prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A family working on a farm with cows, a field and baskets of produce. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "The Farm". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Farm and field, work every day.
Cow and horse, work and play.
Ground below and nature near.
Grow the food during the year.
Strong hand, heavy basket, slow.
Energy and love can grow.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
